newsitem.title: USA: Compaq says no plans to forecast Q2 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Compaq says no plans to forecast Q2 earnings.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said that contrary to market rumors, the company has no plans to forecast its second quarter earnings today, and a Compaq spokeswoman said that "business is good."

Compaq's shares were off 2-1/4 to 100-7/8 in very active trading on market rumors that the world's largest personal computer maker would predict a second quarter earnings shortfall sometime on Wednesday.
"There is a rumor out there that we are going to come out with a pre-announcement," a spokeswoman said. "There has been no pre-announcement and today no pre-announcement is planned."
